points.text: NSE fines M TEK COPPER ₹10,000 plus ₹1,800 GST for late XBRL voting results filing
Fine of ₹10,000 plus ₹1,800 GST; company says no material impact and already filed the XBRL results
NSE levied a fine of **₹10,000** plus **₹1,800 GST** for delay in filing XBRL voting results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
points.quote: NSE has levied a fine of Rs. 10,000/- plus 18% GST 1800/- for non-compliance with Regulation 44(3) of SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015 for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

points.text: Company says it filed XBRL voting results on **October 13, 2026**; NSE notice dated **October 14, 2026**.
points.quote: The Company would like to inform that the aforesaid non-compliance has already been duly rectified and the Company has filed Voting Results in XBRL format dated 13th October, 2026, thereby ensuring compliance with Regulation 44(3) of SEBI LODR Regulations.

points.text: Indian Bank Q2 net profit rose 14.7% YoY to ₹3,462 Cr; GNPA fell to 1.61%
Profit grew on 17.8% higher net interest income and 59% higher non-interest income, while slippages stayed low and coverage held at 98.22%.
Net interest income rose **17.83% YoY to ₹7,719 Cr**; non-interest income grew **59% YoY to ₹3,953 Cr** for the quarter.
points.quote: Net Interest Income increased by 17.83% YoY to ₹7719 Cr in Sep'26 from ₹6551 Cr in Sep'25

points.text: **RAM advances** grew 17.74% YoY to ₹4,42,302 Cr and made up **67.04%** of gross domestic advances.
points.quote: RAM (Retail, Agriculture & MSME) advances grew by 17.74% YoY to ₹442302 Cr in Sep'26 from 375660 Cr in Sep'25

points.text: Cost-to-income improved **555 bps QoQ to 39.25%**; bulk deposits (incl. CD) cut 5.60% QoQ to ₹1.52 lakh Cr.
points.quote: Bank strategically reduced its Bulk deposit (including CD) by 5.60% on QoQ basis, from ₹1.62 lakh Cr in Jun'26 to ₹1.52 lakh Cr in Sep'26

points.text: **PCR including TWO** stood at 98.22% and slippage ratio at 0.69% against 0.79% a year earlier.
points.quote: Provision Coverage Ratio (PCR, including TWO) stood at 98.22% in Sep'26

points.text: UCO Bank and RBL Bank both moved on foreign-currency medium-term note programmes in the past two months; Indian Bank instead raised ₹22,486 Cr of FCNR(B) deposits and ₹3,806 Cr of OFCB.
